decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks are a low-cost addition to the firm's thermoforming material range and had their own page in both observed years, so keeping this cheap option open is sensible.
PETG thermoforming blanks fit the core dental thermoforming business, had a dedicated page throughout the observed period, and cost little to keep in the catalog.
The UV-curing lacquer is only mentioned on the website and its value is still uncertain, but it is a low-cost consumable that complements the portfolio, so the option is worth keeping.

The firm dropped the related custom earmold line in 2019, which signals weakness in the audiology area, but hearing protection earmolds survived that pruning and appear to have held up, so they are kept for now while the risk of dropping them stays elevated.
